title: Reasoning about counterfactual choices and responsibility judgements in children
titleZh: 儿童对反事实选择与责任判断的推理
abstract: Nature Reviews Psychology, Published online: 05 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s44159-026-00632-4 Adults judge responsibility by considering not just what someone chose to do, but also the alternative choices available to them. In this Review, Gautam and Cushman consider three processes involved in children’s understanding of counterfactual choices and their relation to responsibility judgements.
